'''Aurei Eadon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who fought during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Around [[3664 BBY]], Eadon was tasked with protecting a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] [[Mandalorian attack on a Republic envoy|under attack]] by [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and [[Shae Vizla's brother|her brother]]. During the course of the attack, Eadon [[Death/Legends|killed]] Vizla's brother when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] engaged the Jedi Master. Vizla later challenged Eadon to a duel, seeking to avenge her brother's death, but Eadon refused to fight her since he didn't take any pleasure in killing Shae's brother.<ref name="JoMGD" />
